name: multiple-icon-libraries-search
title: Multiple Icon Libraries Search
description: Search Lucide and Hugeicons icons by name or by meaning, switch libraries with one key, and paste or copy any icon's name, SVG, or React code.
author: jasoneric

commands.name: search-icons
commands.title: Search Multiple Icon Libraries
commands.subtitle: Lucide, Hugeicons
commands.description: Search Lucide and free Hugeicons icons by name or meaning, and paste, copy, or save the one you pick.

preferences.name: libraryLucide
preferences.title: Libraries
preferences.label: Lucide
preferences.description: Keep at least one on. ⌘L switches between the ones you turn on.

preferences.name: showFavorites
preferences.title: Favorites
preferences.label: Show favorites before you search
preferences.description: Favorites always come first among search results that match.

preferences.name: enterAction
preferences.title: Enter Action
preferences.description: What Enter does on an icon.

preferences.name: nameFormat
preferences.title: Name Format
preferences.description: Applies to Paste Name and Copy Name.

preferences.name: includeLibraryName
preferences.title: Library Name
preferences.label: Add the library, like "Lucide Ticket" instead of "Ticket"
preferences.description: Helps when you use more than one library.

preferences.name: strokeWidth
preferences.title: Stroke Width
preferences.description: Applies to SVG and React code.

preferences.name: autoAi
preferences.title: Automatic AI
preferences.label: Ask Raycast AI when a search finds fewer than one row of icons
preferences.description: Tab always asks. Uses your Raycast AI allowance.

preferences.name: aiModel
preferences.title: AI Model
preferences.description: All three find about the same icons. Typical wait: DeepSeek 4 s, GPT-5.4 mini 1 s, GPT-6 Luna 2 s.

preferences.name: saveAiKeywords
preferences.title: Remember AI Picks
preferences.label: Save your search words to icons picked from AI results
preferences.description: Next time, those words find the icon without AI.

tools.name: find-icons
tools.title: Find Icons
tools.description: Find Lucide and Hugeicons icons by name or meaning, with each icon's name, React code, and SVG.

ai.instructions: When someone asks for an icon, call find-icons with several comma-separated keywords for what the icon shows or means, most likely first. Show each result's library and name, and give the SVG or React code only when asked. If nothing fits, try again with other words before saying no icon matches.
